Name: Abundant Fish Pond
Author: MoYuCSC
Description:
This mod removes the production limit for fish ponds, allowing them to continue producing on top of existing yields. It is also fully compatible with the MultiSpeciesFishPond mod, providing real-time display of multiple roe outputs.
此模组突破鱼塘的产出上限，可以让鱼塘在已有产出上继续产出。其次它还兼容了MultiSpeciesFishPond模组，可以实时展示多种鱼籽的产出

Manifest.Name: 丰收鱼塘 AbundantFishPond
Manifest.Description: 突破鱼塘的鱼数与鱼籽上限：鱼塘可无限累积鱼，鱼籽产出自动堆叠，鱼籽气泡右下角显示各品种累积数量。兼容鱼塘混养模组（Multi Species Fish Pond）。
Manifest.Author: MoYu
